listingTitle: Compile constant Rust regexes outside loops
title: Compile constant Rust regexes outside loops
why: Regex construction parses and compiles the pattern, so repeating it for every iteration adds avoidable CPU work and allocation.
suggestion: Compile the constant pattern once before the loop or store it in LazyLock, then reuse the Regex.
limitations: Only Regex or RegexBuilder constructors whose first argument is a string literal inside a braced loop are reported.
Aliases, wrapper constructors, macro-generated patterns, and dynamically computed patterns are not inferred.
